symptom: `mxcli diff` renders an existing enumeration as `create enumeration .Enum_DistanceUnit (` (empty module name) and reports an untouched enumeration as modified
cause: The enumeration is inside a FOLDER, so its ContainerID is the folder's ID. diffEnumeration called `h.GetModuleName(existingEnum.ContainerID)`, which only knows module IDs, instead of walking up with FindModuleID first. findEnumeration had matched through the walk, so the lookup succeeded and only the rendering lost the module. Same class as the DROP ENUMERATION folder bug (#976): a second resolver for one question
insight: `GetModuleName` takes a MODULE ID; anything whose ContainerID can be a folder (enumerations, flows, pages, constants...) must go through `GetModuleName(FindModuleID(...))` or `GetQualifiedName`. Domain models are always module-contained, which is why entity/association/view-entity diffs were fine. Checked every diff kind in one table (stored side must never contain an empty qualifier, plus flowNameMaps for references inside flows); PedApp's NanoflowCommons.Enum_DistanceUnit (folder Geolocation) reproduces it end to end: old binary 1 modified, fixed 1 unchanged
